description: Meryl Stryfe and Milly Thompson are agents of the Bernardelli Insurance Society, combing the wasteland to evaluate and report on claims made against Vash the Stampede.
summon: Please accept this token of good will!
fusion:
Aren't you glad, ma'am?
It's no cause for gladness!
evolution:
Oh, isn't it lovely today?
It sure is!
It makes you want to sit here forever, doesn't it?
